# The example from Sims  tutorial

```{r}
cost_diet <- 50.0
cost_exercise <- 750.0
cost_stent <- 5000.0
```


```{r}
decision_node = DecisionNode$new("Programme")

chance_node_diet <- ChanceNode$new("Outcome")
chance_node_exercise <- ChanceNode$new("Outcome")

leaf_node_diet_no_stent <- LeafNode$new("No intervention")
leaf_node_diet_stent <- LeafNode$new("Intervention")
leaf_node_exercise_no_stent <- LeafNode$new("No intervention")
leaf_node_exercise_stent <- LeafNode$new("Intervention")



```


```{r}
action_diet <- Action$new(
  decision_node, chance_node_diet, cost = cost_diet, label = "Diet"
)
action_exercise <- Action$new(
  decision_node, chance_node_exercise, cost = cost_exercise, label = "Exercise"
)
```


```{r}
s_diet <- 12L
f_diet <- 56L
s_exercise <- 18L
f_exercise <- 40L
```


```{r}
ip_diet <- f_diet / (s_diet + f_diet)
ip_exercise <- f_exercise / (s_exercise + f_exercise)
nnt <- 1.0 / (ip_diet - ip_exercise)

p_diet <- 1.0 - ip_diet
p_exercise <- 1.0 - ip_exercise



```


```{r}
reaction_diet_success <- Reaction$new(
  chance_node_diet, leaf_node_diet_no_stent,
  p = p_diet, cost = 0.0, label = "Success"
)

reaction_diet_failure <- Reaction$new(
  chance_node_diet, leaf_node_diet_stent,
  p = NA_real_, cost = cost_stent, label = "Failure"
)

reaction_exercise_success <- Reaction$new(
  chance_node_exercise, leaf_node_exercise_no_stent,
  p = p_exercise, cost = 0.0, label = "Success"
)

reaction_exercise_failure <- Reaction$new(
  chance_node_exercise, leaf_node_exercise_stent,
  p = NA_real_, cost = cost_stent, label = "Failure"
)
```


```{r}
dt <- DecisionTree$new(
  V = list(
    decision_node,
    chance_node_diet,
    chance_node_exercise,
    leaf_node_diet_no_stent,
    leaf_node_diet_stent,
    leaf_node_exercise_no_stent,
    leaf_node_exercise_stent
  ),
  E = list(
    action_diet,
    action_exercise,
    reaction_diet_success,
    reaction_diet_failure,
    reaction_exercise_success,
    reaction_exercise_failure
  )
)
```


```{r}
dt$draw()
```

```{r}
rs <- dt$evaluate()
rs
```


# Raiffa1


```{r}
library(rdecision)

# --- 1. Define Values ---
pay_win     <- 100.0
pay_lose    <- 0.0
pay_safe    <- 40.0
cost_sample <- 5.0

# --- 2. Create the Nodes ---
d_root <- DecisionNode$new("Root: Initial Choice")
l_safe <- LeafNode$new("Safe Payout")

# B. The Immediate Gamble Nodes
d_gamble    <- DecisionNode$new("Gamble: Which Urn?")
c_gamble_u1 <- ChanceNode$new("Guess U1 (No Sample)")
c_gamble_u2 <- ChanceNode$new("Guess U2 (No Sample)")

# C. The Sampling Nodes
c_sample <- ChanceNode$new("Sample: Draw a Ball")
d_black  <- DecisionNode$new("Sampled Black: Which Urn?")
d_red    <- DecisionNode$new("Sampled Red: Which Urn?")

c_b_guess_u1 <- ChanceNode$new("True State (Black -> Guess U1)")
c_b_guess_u2 <- ChanceNode$new("True State (Black -> Guess U2)")
c_r_guess_u1 <- ChanceNode$new("True State (Red -> Guess U1)")
c_r_guess_u2 <- ChanceNode$new("True State (Red -> Guess U2)")

# UNIQUE Leaf Nodes (rdecision requires strict trees, no converging branches)
l_g_u1_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Gamble U1)")
l_g_u1_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Gamble U1)")
l_g_u2_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Gamble U2)")
l_g_u2_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Gamble U2)")

l_b_u1_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Black->U1)")
l_b_u1_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Black->U1)")
l_b_u2_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Black->U2)")
l_b_u2_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Black->U2)")

l_r_u1_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Red->U1)")
l_r_u1_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Red->U1)")
l_r_u2_w <- LeafNode$new("Win (Red->U2)")
l_r_u2_l <- LeafNode$new("Lose (Red->U2)")


# --- 3. Wire the Tree (Create Edges) ---

# Root Actions 
e_safe   <- Action$new(d_root, l_safe, cost = -pay_safe, label = "Take Safe ($40)")
e_gamble <- Action$new(d_root, d_gamble, cost = 0.0, label = "Gamble Immediately")
e_sample <- Action$new(d_root, c_sample, cost = cost_sample, label = "Sample ($5)")

# Immediate Gamble Edges (Prior Probabilities: 50/50)
e_g_u1      <- Action$new(d_gamble, c_gamble_u1, label = "Guess Urn 1")
e_g_u2      <- Action$new(d_gamble, c_gamble_u2, label = "Guess Urn 2")
e_g_u1_win  <- Reaction$new(c_gamble_u1, l_g_u1_w, p = 0.5, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 1")
e_g_u1_lose <- Reaction$new(c_gamble_u1, l_g_u1_l, p = 0.5, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 2")
e_g_u2_win  <- Reaction$new(c_gamble_u2, l_g_u2_w, p = 0.5, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 2")
e_g_u2_lose <- Reaction$new(c_gamble_u2, l_g_u2_l, p = 0.5, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 1")

# Sampling Edges (Chance of drawing Red or Black is 50/50)
e_draw_b <- Reaction$new(c_sample, d_black, p = 0.5, label = "Draw Black")
e_draw_r <- Reaction$new(c_sample, d_red, p = 0.5, label = "Draw Red")

# Decisions After Drawing a BLACK Ball (Posteriors: 70% U1, 30% U2)
e_b_u1      <- Action$new(d_black, c_b_guess_u1, label = "Guess Urn 1")
e_b_u2      <- Action$new(d_black, c_b_guess_u2, label = "Guess Urn 2")
e_b_u1_win  <- Reaction$new(c_b_guess_u1, l_b_u1_w, p = 0.7, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 1")
e_b_u1_lose <- Reaction$new(c_b_guess_u1, l_b_u1_l, p = 0.3, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 2")
e_b_u2_lose <- Reaction$new(c_b_guess_u2, l_b_u2_l, p = 0.7, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 1")
e_b_u2_win  <- Reaction$new(c_b_guess_u2, l_b_u2_w, p = 0.3, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 2")

# Decisions After Drawing a RED Ball (Posteriors: 30% U1, 70% U2)
e_r_u1      <- Action$new(d_red, c_r_guess_u1, label = "Guess Urn 1")
e_r_u2      <- Action$new(d_red, c_r_guess_u2, label = "Guess Urn 2")
e_r_u1_win  <- Reaction$new(c_r_guess_u1, l_r_u1_w, p = 0.3, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 1")
e_r_u1_lose <- Reaction$new(c_r_guess_u1, l_r_u1_l, p = 0.7, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 2")
e_r_u2_lose <- Reaction$new(c_r_guess_u2, l_r_u2_l, p = 0.3, cost = -pay_lose, label = "Is Urn 1")
e_r_u2_win  <- Reaction$new(c_r_guess_u2, l_r_u2_w, p = 0.7, cost = -pay_win, label = "Is Urn 2")

# --- 4. Build and Evaluate ---
dt <- DecisionTree$new(
  V = list(d_root, l_safe, d_gamble, c_gamble_u1, c_gamble_u2, 
           c_sample, d_black, d_red, c_b_guess_u1, c_b_guess_u2, 
           c_r_guess_u1, c_r_guess_u2, 
           l_g_u1_w, l_g_u1_l, l_g_u2_w, l_g_u2_l,
           l_b_u1_w, l_b_u1_l, l_b_u2_w, l_b_u2_l,
           l_r_u1_w, l_r_u1_l, l_r_u2_w, l_r_u2_l),
  E = list(e_safe, e_gamble, e_sample, e_g_u1, e_g_u2, e_g_u1_win, e_g_u1_lose, 
           e_g_u2_win, e_g_u2_lose, e_draw_b, e_draw_r, e_b_u1, e_b_u2, 
           e_b_u1_win, e_b_u1_lose, e_b_u2_lose, e_b_u2_win, e_r_u1, e_r_u2, 
           e_r_u1_win, e_r_u1_lose, e_r_u2_lose, e_r_u2_win)
)

# Look at the 'Cost' column for expected payouts (represented as negatives)
cat("Optimal Baseline Strategy Evaluation:\n")
print(dt$evaluate())
```

```{r}
dt$draw()
```


## Wildcatter

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. SETUP & BAYESIAN INFERENCE (BASE R)
# ==============================================================================
library(rdecision)

# Prior probabilities of the ground state: P(State)
priors <- c(Dry = 0.5, Wet = 0.3, Soaking = 0.2)

# Likelihood Matrix: P(Test Result | Ground State)
likelihoods <- matrix(
  c(0.6, 0.3, 0.1,  # P(Result | Dry)
    0.3, 0.4, 0.3,  # P(Result | Wet)
    0.1, 0.3, 0.6), # P(Result | Soaking)
  nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(Result = c("Diffuse", "Open", "Closed"), 
                  State = c("Dry", "Wet", "Soaking"))
)

# Compute Joint, Marginal, and Posterior Probabilities
joint <- likelihoods * rep(priors, each = 3)
marginals <- rowSums(joint)
posteriors <- joint / marginals

# Financial constants
cost_test  <- -10000    
cost_drill <- -70000    

payoff_dry   <- 0       
payoff_wet   <- 120000  
payoff_soak  <- 270000  

# ==============================================================================
# 2. BUILDING THE DECISION TREE (rdecision)
# ==============================================================================

# --- A. Define Nodes ---
d_root <- DecisionNode$new("Test?")
c_test_outcome <- ChanceNode$new("Test Outcome")

d_no_test    <- DecisionNode$new("Drill? (No Test)")
d_if_diffuse <- DecisionNode$new("Drill? (Diffuse)")
d_if_open    <- DecisionNode$new("Drill? (Open)")
d_if_closed  <- DecisionNode$new("Drill? (Closed)")

c_state_notest  <- ChanceNode$new("Oil State (No Test)")
c_state_diffuse <- ChanceNode$new("Oil State (Diffuse)")
c_state_open    <- ChanceNode$new("Oil State (Open)")
c_state_closed  <- ChanceNode$new("Oil State (Closed)")

# --- B. Define UNIQUE Terminal Leaf Nodes ---
# Leaf nodes for NO TEST path
leaf_abort   <- LeafNode$new("Walked Away ($0)")
leaf_nt_dry  <- LeafNode$new("No-Test Dry Well")
leaf_nt_wet  <- LeafNode$new("No-Test Wet Well")
leaf_nt_soak <- LeafNode$new("No-Test Soaking Well")

# Leaf nodes for DIFFUSE test path
leaf_abort_diffuse <- LeafNode$new("Walked Away (Diffuse, -$10k)")
leaf_dif_dry       <- LeafNode$new("Diffuse Tested Dry")
leaf_dif_wet       <- LeafNode$new("Diffuse Tested Wet")
leaf_dif_soak      <- LeafNode$new("Diffuse Tested Soaking")

# Leaf nodes for OPEN test path
leaf_abort_open <- LeafNode$new("Walked Away (Open, -$10k)")
leaf_op_dry     <- LeafNode$new("Open Tested Dry")
leaf_op_wet     <- LeafNode$new("Open Tested Wet")
leaf_op_soak    <- LeafNode$new("Open Tested Soaking")

# Leaf nodes for CLOSED test path
leaf_abort_closed <- LeafNode$new("Walked Away (Closed, -$10k)")
leaf_cl_dry       <- LeafNode$new("Closed Tested Dry")
leaf_cl_wet       <- LeafNode$new("Closed Tested Wet")
leaf_cl_soak      <- LeafNode$new("Closed Tested Soaking")


# --- C. Define Edges (Branches) ---
edge_action_test   <- Action$new(d_root, c_test_outcome, cost = cost_test, label = "Test")
edge_action_notest <- Action$new(d_root, d_no_test, cost = 0, label = "Don't Test")

edge_res_diffuse <- Reaction$new(c_test_outcome, d_if_diffuse, p = marginals["Diffuse"], label = "Diffuse")
edge_res_open    <- Reaction$new(c_test_outcome, d_if_open, p = marginals["Open"], label = "Open")
edge_res_closed  <- Reaction$new(c_test_outcome, d_if_closed, p = marginals["Closed"], label = "Closed")

# Drill Choices under NO TEST
edge_nt_abort <- Action$new(d_no_test, leaf_abort, cost = 0, label = "No Drill")
edge_nt_drill <- Action$new(d_no_test, c_state_notest, cost = cost_drill, label = "Drill")

# Drill Choices under DIFFUSE path
edge_diffuse_abort <- Action$new(d_if_diffuse, leaf_abort_diffuse, cost = 0, label = "No Drill")
edge_diffuse_drill <- Action$new(d_if_diffuse, c_state_diffuse, cost = cost_drill, label = "Drill")

# Drill Choices under OPEN path
edge_open_abort <- Action$new(d_if_open, leaf_abort_open, cost = 0, label = "No Drill")
edge_open_drill <- Action$new(d_if_open, c_state_open, cost = cost_drill, label = "Drill")

# Drill Choices under CLOSED path
edge_closed_abort <- Action$new(d_if_closed, leaf_abort_closed, cost = 0, label = "No Drill")
edge_closed_drill <- Action$new(d_if_closed, c_state_closed, cost = cost_drill, label = "Drill")


# --- D. Map Chance Outcomes ---
# Under NO TEST path (Priors)
r_nt_dry  <- Reaction$new(c_state_notest, leaf_nt_dry, p = priors["Dry"], benefit = payoff_dry, label = "Dry")
r_nt_wet  <- Reaction$new(c_state_notest, leaf_nt_wet, p = priors["Wet"], benefit = payoff_wet, label = "Wet")
r_nt_soak <- Reaction$new(c_state_notest, leaf_nt_soak, p = priors["Soaking"], benefit = payoff_soak, label = "Soaking")

# Under DIFFUSE path (Diffuse Posteriors)
r_dif_dry  <- Reaction$new(c_state_diffuse, leaf_dif_dry, p = posteriors["Diffuse", "Dry"], benefit = payoff_dry, label = "Dry")
r_dif_wet  <- Reaction$new(c_state_diffuse, leaf_dif_wet, p = posteriors["Diffuse", "Wet"], benefit = payoff_wet, label = "Wet")
r_dif_soak <- Reaction$new(c_state_diffuse, leaf_dif_soak, p = posteriors["Diffuse", "Soaking"], benefit = payoff_soak, label = "Soaking")

# Under OPEN path (Open Posteriors)
r_op_dry  <- Reaction$new(c_state_open, leaf_op_dry, p = posteriors["Open", "Dry"], benefit = payoff_dry, label = "Dry")
r_op_wet  <- Reaction$new(c_state_open, leaf_op_wet, p = posteriors["Open", "Wet"], benefit = payoff_wet, label = "Wet")
r_op_soak <- Reaction$new(c_state_open, leaf_op_soak, p = posteriors["Open", "Soaking"], benefit = payoff_soak, label = "Soaking")

# Under CLOSED path (Closed Posteriors)
r_cl_dry  <- Reaction$new(c_state_closed, leaf_cl_dry, p = posteriors["Closed", "Dry"], benefit = payoff_dry, label = "Dry")
r_cl_wet  <- Reaction$new(c_state_closed, leaf_cl_wet, p = posteriors["Closed", "Wet"], benefit = payoff_wet, label = "Wet")
r_cl_soak <- Reaction$new(c_state_closed, leaf_cl_soak, p = posteriors["Closed", "Soaking"], benefit = payoff_soak, label = "Soaking")


# ==============================================================================
# 3. SOLVE AND PRINT THE PATHWAY ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

# Compile completely separate elements into the node list
nodes_list <- list(
  d_root, c_test_outcome, d_no_test, d_if_diffuse, d_if_open, d_if_closed,
  c_state_notest, c_state_diffuse, c_state_open, c_state_closed,
  leaf_abort, leaf_nt_dry, leaf_nt_wet, leaf_nt_soak,
  leaf_abort_diffuse, leaf_dif_dry, leaf_dif_wet, leaf_dif_soak,
  leaf_abort_open, leaf_op_dry, leaf_op_wet, leaf_op_soak,
  leaf_abort_closed, leaf_cl_dry, leaf_cl_wet, leaf_cl_soak
)

edges_list <- list(
  edge_action_test, edge_action_notest, edge_res_diffuse, edge_res_open, edge_res_closed,
  edge_nt_abort, edge_nt_drill, edge_diffuse_abort, edge_diffuse_drill,
  edge_open_abort, edge_open_drill, edge_closed_abort, edge_closed_drill,
  r_nt_dry, r_nt_wet, r_nt_soak, r_dif_dry, r_dif_wet, r_dif_soak,
  r_op_dry, r_op_wet, r_op_soak, r_cl_dry, r_cl_wet, r_cl_soak
)

tree <- DecisionTree$new(V = nodes_list, E = edges_list)

# CRITICAL FIX: Evaluate by "path" to unlock individual branch breakdowns
results <- tree$evaluate(by = "path")

# Select the exact valid column headers generated by rdecision's path mode
clean_summary <- results[, c("Leaf", "Probability", "Cost", "Benefit", "Utility")]

# Print the final result matrix
print(clean_summary)


```


```{r}
tree$draw()

```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 4. CONDENSE AND DISPLAY THE OPTIMAL STRATEGY
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Evaluate by strategy (default), which folds back and rolls up the tree
strat_results <- tree$evaluate()

# 2. Sort the strategies from highest expected profit to lowest
strat_sorted <- strat_results[order(-strat_results$Cost - strat_results$Benefit), ]

# 3. Clean up column names for readability (replaces punctuation with spaces)
colnames(strat_sorted) <- gsub("\\.", " ", colnames(strat_sorted))

# 4. Extract and print only the top-performing strategy profile
# This isolates the optimal path and displays its rolled-up financial metrics
winning_strategy <- head(strat_sorted, 1)

print(winning_strategy)
```
